High-Yield Savings

Every Apex account comes with High-Yield Savings. Interest is worked out on your balance each day and paid in daily, so it starts earning interest of its own straight away.

  • 4.50% Annual Percentage Yield
  • Interest paid into your balance every day
  • Move money back to checking whenever you like

Keep $10,000 saved for a year and you'd earn about $450 in interest.

Apex credit card

Every purchase on your Apex credit card earns 1.5% back, with no categories to track and no cap on what you can earn.

  • 1.5% back on every card purchase
  • Redeem from $1.00, whenever you like
  • Send it to checking or use it as a statement credit

Spend $800 on your card in a month and you'd earn $12.00 back.

Card autopay

Pick how much to pay and we'll pay your Apex card from Primary Checking on each due date, the 20th of the month.

  • Choose the minimum, the statement balance or the full balance
  • Paid from checking on the 20th
  • Change it or turn it off any time
Savings goals

Name what you're saving for, set a target, and let the spare change from your card purchases do some of the work.

  • Up to 10 goals, each with a target and a date
  • Round-ups move your spare change into a goal once a day
  • Take money out any time
Linked accounts

Link the apps and banks you already use, then move money between them and Apex checking.

  • Link with a $Cashtag, username, email, phone or bank account number
  • Add up to $2,500 and send up to $5,000 a day
  • Every link is verified before money can move
Budgets

Set a monthly limit for the categories you care about, and we'll keep count as you spend.

  • Limits for groceries, dining, shopping and more
  • Alerts at 80% and again at 100% of each limit
  • A safe-to-spend amount per day for the rest of the month

Download my data

Get a copy of everything we hold about you in one file. You can keep it, or open it in any text editor.

  • Your profile and settings
  • Your accounts (numbers shortened to the last 4 digits)
  • Every transaction
  • Savings goals and budgets
  • Messages with our support team
  • Notifications, sign-ins and devices

Passwords, passcodes, PINs and security keys are never included. We'll notify you whenever your data is downloaded.
